text: dsh-rick（DSH Web 插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Rick and Morty 风格的 C-137 主题皮肤。客户端在 General 设置中注册皮肤选择行，并在 shell overlay 注册 Rick、Morty 和传送门宠物；主机端提供海报、宠物图片及样式资源。用户可从 28 张内置海报中选择背景，也可添加自定义图片并调整背景透明度。适合想为 DSH Web 更换视觉主题并添加桌面互动宠物的用户。安装需 DSH Web 0.2.x。

dsh-rick (DSH Web plugin): Add a Rick and Morty C-137 skin to DeepSeek Harness. Choose among 28 built-in posters or add a custom background and adjust its opacity. Rick, Morty, and a portal appear in the shell overlay; drag pets into the portal and summon them. Requires DSH Web 0.2.x.
想给 DSH Web 换成 Rick and Morty 风格的主题
能不能把自己的图片设成 DSH 背景？
I want animated desktop pets in my DSH interface.
dsh-rick 的功能「选择主题背景」：在 General 设置的皮肤行中切换默认外观、28 张内置海报或已添加的自定义场景，并可调整背景透明度。
dsh-rick 的功能「桌面宠物与传送门」：选择 C-137 皮肤后，Rick 和 Morty 会出现在 shell overlay；用户可拖动宠物并通过 Rick 的传送门枪让宠物进出传送门。
dsh-rick 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 29 天；提交数 14；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-rick README · dsh-rick：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

C-137 skin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): 28 catalog posters, user-added scenes, neon chrome, and overlay pets (Rick, Morty, portal gun).

Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2). 0.1.x and earlier used the pre-0.2.0 settings model, which this plugin no longer targets.
dsh-rick README · dsh-rick：Installable with `dsh plugin add` (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`). Listed format follows [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin).

dsh-rick README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xxxrickymorty-dev/dsh-rick
dsh web
```

dsh-rick README · Install：Then Settings → General → Skin. Default has no Remove control; every poster and custom card does. Pick a poster to turn C-137 on (pins dark without changing Appearance). Click Rick for catchphrases; **Portal gun** draws the gun, the next Rick click fires the portal. Drag Rick or Morty onto the portal to pocket them. With both inside, click to summon Rick, click again for Morty, then click to shrink the portal closed.

dsh-rick README · Install：Do not install this plugin on a DeepSeek Harness build that already vendors C-137 inside `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme`. Two Skin rows would appear and both would write `data-dsh-skin`.

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-rick
```

dsh-rick README · What it adds：- Skin row after Appearance: Default, custom scenes (max 12), catalog `01`–`28`, Add image
- Durable `c137` settings section: the Loader row id IS the namespace (`id: c137` in `cordis.patch.yml`), declaring `skin`, `skinBackground`, `skinBgOpacity`, `customScenes`, and `hiddenCatalog` as one volatile `Config` schema, so a skin change commits into the running config without remounting the plugin
- Overlay pets on `shell.overlay` while the skin is `c137` (cap 4)
- C-137's palette registered as a ui-theme alias-token layer via `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`, held only while the skin is on; the surfaces go translucent there so the `body::before` poster layer reads through the chrome
- Host route `/dsh-c137/*` for posters, pet frames, and `c137.css`
dsh-rick README · What it adds：Does not change `agent-loop` or the session log. Catchphrases stay English in every locale.

dsh-rick README · How the skin paints：This plugin draws none of the application chrome, so its visual half is entirely
document-level: the `body[data-dsh-skin='c137']` attributes the static stylesheet
keys off, plus the alias-token layer.

dsh-rick README · How the skin paints：The token layer is the only mechanism that can win. ui-theme's presenter projects
the active tokens as **inline** styles on `body`, so a stylesheet rule that
redefines a `--dsw-*` token is silently outranked; registering a layer folds the
values into the active definition instead, so the presenter writes ours. The
presenter also owns `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` and the root `color-scheme`,
deriving both from the Appearance preference, so a skin that pins dark re-asserts
them through a `MutationObserver` rather than changing that preference.

dsh-rick README · How the skin paints：Structure is the part that cannot be re-targeted: 0.2.0 renders the frame and
sidebar with hashed CSS-module classes and exposes no stable attribute for them,
so the column-level rules this skin once used (`[data-app-frame]`,
`[data-app-sidebar]`, `[data-message-bubble]`, …) no longer match anything. Their
surfaces come from tokens instead. `[data-composer-seat]` and
`[data-composer-card]` are the two stable chrome hooks the stylesheet still uses.

dsh-rick README · Layout：```
index.js              # Host: settings schema + static assets
cordis.patch.yml      # dsh.bundle patch (required for `dsh plugin add`)
lib/client.js         # Prebuilt browser factory (`window.__ModuleLoader__`)
assets/               # c137.css, scenes/bg-NN.png, pets/*.png

dsh-rick README · Rebuild the client bundle：```sh
npm install
npm run build
```
